dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular, thin-lined high-intensity perimeters forming closed 'O' and open 'C' shapes with sharp pixel-level transitions between the bright white/light-grey outlines and the surrounding dark-grey pelage.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of high-intensity pixel clusters forming the ring perimeters, concentrated most heavily along the mid-dorsal and lateral-posterior regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A prominent triad of large macro-annuli centroids on the upper lateral flank forms an obtuse triangle; a secondary cluster of four smaller annuli in the mid-dorsal region forms a roughly trapezoidal geometric relationship.
